release_requirements: HANDOFF_READY wave item with persisted approval diagnostics
READY proof pack matching the package portfolio and rebalance run
current mandate and model versions matching the reviewed request
READY persisted run with exact security quantities and supported dependencies
one complete account-scoped instrument mapping per source intent
pinned funding evidence and certified reserve validation when applicable

durability.replay: exact identity and immutable material replay returns the stored package; changed material conflicts; a later approved set for the same wave item must explicitly supersede an existing package version
durability.pagination: tenant-fenced deterministic created-at snapshot; all pages are required for completeness

non_claims: approval material preview is not a released package
package retrieval is not order submission or acknowledgement
retrieval receipt is not a fill, settlement, cancellation, reconciliation, or booking event
lotus-manage does not route an order, receive execution state, or authoritatively book the core transaction
caller-supplied identity headers are not production IdP certification
the synthetic adapter tests are not bank or production integration certification
external_owner_dependencies: execution adapter submission and acknowledgement contract
authoritative core booking and reconciliation contract
production IdP-backed tenant, actor, and entitlement admission
